core.notes:
Profile data now stays up to date in the background without you opening each page: only what your loaded modules use, a few reads an hour, from one tab
Tabs now share only what changed, and a tab never undoes something another tab saw more recently
Tools ask for their data once when you open them, and their Sync button asks only for what that tool uses
Profile Sync shows how each section is kept (Kept) and what the background did in the last hour
The Profile Sync light turns amber only for old data a loaded module uses; other old data shows as "old · unused"
"Background reads" (Profile Sync › Syncing) replaces "Keep party data open"
Fixed: your level was not synced
Fixed: hovering another player's village could overwrite your own village
Modules can share their readings with each other (the Pet Slot Alarm uses Party's), so nothing is read twice
Profile Sync now keeps all your loadouts: every sculpture preset's grid (not only the one you last looked at), your skill-tree presets, and your item sets

modules.label: Dungeon Win Rate
modules.notes:
Fixed: Clear left the old results on screen and brought them back on the next save; it now clears them completely (and waits while a scan runs)
Runs on Queslar 2 only (v2.queslar.com and its test server)
The top-bar button now reads "Dungeon WR"
Switching it off now fully unloads it; a scan in progress stops, and every page it already read is kept

modules.label: Sculpture Grid Labels
modules.notes:
A rotate button beside the overlay switch swaps the labels between roll % and the sculpture's item level (can be hidden in its settings)
Switching it off now fully unloads it, and it is grouped with the other page tweaks
